evals.name: request handling catches introduced and inherited secret exposure
evals.prompt: Use $code-review to review the local diff represented by tests/fixtures/code-review/fixtures/security-diff/before.py and after.py. Lead with findings only if there is a high-confidence bug or rule violation.

expected_findings.why: The change logs headers that include the Authorization value, violating the fixture AGENTS.md rule and exposing request credentials.

The same request handler returns Authorization in its response, which the applicable AGENTS.md also forbids. This existing output violation remains on the reviewed path; distinguish it from the new logging exposure.

should_not_report: building Authorization headers for internal use as a defect in itself
generic missing tests without a concrete failure mode

evals.name: navigation change covers the existing state owner
evals.prompt: Use $code-review to review the before.py to after.py change in tests/fixtures/code-review/fixtures/execution-navigation against CONTRACT.md. The other files are existing implementation context. Return findings; do not modify files.

expected_findings.why: Refresh retains older runs but replaces their source map; navigating a retained record fails. Reconcile both maps consistently while preserving retained records.
open_record discards a metadata read immediately before navigate reads the same metadata again. Remove the extra call rather than add caching or coordination.

should_not_report: removing host authorization or stale-revision protection
the source-map defect as introduced by this patch
the duplicate read as multiple separate findings
